hard_negative_evidence_stops.condition: Any faithful non-oracle baseline ties or beats candidate on primary heldout metric.
ngram_trace_lookup or nearest_neighbor_trace_retrieval reaches candidate-equivalent performance.
Any leakage positive control fails to detect injected leakage.
Replay can pass from stored outputs, stored actions, trace-only comparison, or hashes.
Any declared heldout split, counterfactual pair, frozen seed, context ID, or episode ID is unused.
Candidate score improves but only through schema, config, ID, prompt, filename, path, or scoring-artifact leakage.
Ablation drop exists but faithful baselines still solve the task.
Candidate advantage depends on denying faithful baselines candidate-equivalent visible information.
Task becomes a same-family 002C patch, 002E variant, or local toy hardening route.

closure_rule: A hard negative-evidence stop must preserve the failed result and must not be repaired by threshold tuning, field hiding, rerun selection, or same-family patching inside the same task.
claim_ceiling: future stop-condition contract only; no future execution verdict is claimed by this task
